title: Carried-binding refusal repeats one loss up to three times for repeated words, and says "1 current criteria"
outcome: In src/acceptance_evaluation_carried_binding.rs, the per-wording cap check runs even when the main matching has already reported every judged binding with those words. One loss is then reported up to three times. Example: judged ["A test covers it" x2], both bound to `test`; current ["A test covers it"] unbound. The result is two per-binding lines plus a per-word line. The refusal stays correct. Fix: skip the per-word line for a wording whose members the main matching already left unmatched, or merge the lines, and pin the line count in a test. Also use singular and plural forms in "{n} current criteria still carry those words". Add a clause to the refusal-content sentence in docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md for the per-word line.
acceptance: Carried-binding refusal repeats one loss up to three times for repeated words, and says "1 current criteria" is done
